subject: Request: Temporary net terms + credit guardrails for Crescendo AI
messages:
From: Kai Ramos <kai.ramos@crescendo.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Crescendo Finance <finance@crescendo.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Temporary net terms + credit guardrails for Crescendo AI

Hi Sean / Marissa,

Hope you both had a good week. Quick note from Crescendo finance — we received Redwood's April invoice (attached) and SOW v2 and are working through a tight month-end cash position because one of our enterprise customers pushed payment into May.

Would Redwood be open to a temporary Net60 for April's invoice only, with a capped credit line while we finish the customer collection? Our proposal:
- Net60 on invoice #2027-04-01 (total $145,200)
- 20% upfront within 5 business days, remainder on Net60
- Credit cap request: $125,000 (to limit Redwood exposure)

We also have an EU subsidiary question: the invoice shows VAT handling on the SOW — can you confirm whether Redwood expects reverse-charge or will apply VAT? Elena (cc'd) will provide Crescendo's EU VAT registration if needed.

Attached: invoice-20270401.pdf, SOW-Crescendo-v2.pdf

Appreciate a quick signal so we can route approvals.

Best,
Kai Ramos
Head of Business Ops
Crescendo AI

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Ramos <kai.ramos@crescendo.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Crescendo Finance <finance@crescendo.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary net terms + credit guardrails for Crescendo AI

Thanks for the context, Kai — sorry to hear about the timing mismatch. We can be flexible but want to balance commercial risk for Redwood. Initial position: we can pilot a temporary Net45 (90-day trial), subject to credit confirmation and receipt of a PO.

Could you:
- Send a PO referencing invoice #2027-04-01
- Provide Crescendo's EU VAT registration certificate (if we need to apply reverse-charge)
- Confirm whether the requested credit cap should apply across all open invoices or just this invoice

I'll loop Finance to run a quick check; Monica, can you start the PO/collections template? I attached a short PO template for ease.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: temporary-PO-template.docx

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Kai Ramos <kai.ramos@crescendo.ai>
Cc: Crescendo Finance <finance@crescendo.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary net terms + credit guardrails for Crescendo AI

Sean/Kai — quick finance note. We can provisionally support a staggered payment option but need the following to protect Redwood:

- Completed credit-request-form.xlsx (attached) with recent bank ref and trade refs
- Proof of EU VAT registration (if client expects reverse-charge)
- Proposal from our side: 30% upfront, 35% at Day 30, 35% at Day 60 (for Net60 remainder)
- If Crescendo prefers 20% upfront, we'll require a capped credit line of $120k plus a one-time fee (1.5% of invoice) and a payment guarantee email from the CFO.

Operational items: we'll set an automatic reminders cadence and a late fee of 1.25% monthly beyond Net60. If all docs clear, Finance will issue an invoice schedule and update the AR ledger so collections can monitor.

Attachment: credit-request-form.xlsx

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kai Ramos <kai.ramos@crescendo.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@crescendo.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Crescendo Finance <finance@crescendo.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary net terms + credit guardrails for Crescendo AI

Thanks Olga — Elena (cc) attached Crescendo's VAT cert and bank ref in a separate message (sending now). We can complete the credit form ASAP. A couple of asks on your proposals:

- Crescendo is comfortable with the 30/35/35 split in principle, but given the timing pressure we'd prefer to reduce the upfront to 20% if Redwood can extend Net60 on the balance without the 1.5% fee.
- If Redwood insists on 30% upfront, we accept but request a reduced credit cap of $100k to match our current liquidity.

Would Redwood accept: 20% upfront, Net60 remainder in two equal installments (40% Day 30, 40% Day 60), with a $120k credit cap and standard reminders? If so, we'll finalize the credit form and PO this afternoon.

Appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Kai

Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Crescendo Finance <finance@crescendo.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary net terms + credit guardrails for Crescendo AI

Kai — appreciate you moving quickly. From a sales/relationship perspective, I recommend we accept the 20% upfront + Net60 remainder in two equal installments, with the following guardrails to mitigate risk:

- Credit cap: $120,000 (applies to all open invoices during the pilot period)
- One-time administrative fee: waived for this customer (we'll absorb) but require a signed amendment to the MPA
- Late fee clause: 1.25% monthly after Net60; we will keep reminders at Day 15, Day 30, Day 45
- Collections: automatic AR flags if Day 30 installment not received; account to be flagged for suspension at Day 75 if overdue

I've drafted a short amendment that tracks these terms — attaching redwood-term-amendment-draft.pdf. If Crescendo signs, Finance will generate the invoice schedule and we'll route DocuSign for the MPA amendment.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-term-amendment-draft.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Ramos <kai.ramos@crescendo.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Crescendo Finance <finance@crescendo.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary net terms + credit guardrails for Crescendo AI

Kai — thank you. Based on the inputs from Finance and Sales we will proceed as follows (final):

- Payment: 20% upfront within 5 business days, remainder on Net60 split into two equal installments: 40% Day 30 / 40% Day 60
- Credit cap: $120,000 (applies enterprise-wide for the pilot)
- Administrative fee: waived (one-time)
- Late fee: 1.25% monthly after Net60; automated reminders at Day 15/30/45
- VAT: Redwood will apply reverse-charge for EU invoices on receipt of Crescendo's VAT registration (Elena's file confirmed)
- Next steps: Crescendo to return signed amendment via DocuSign; Finance (Olga) will issue the invoice schedule and update AR ledger.

I'll sign off on this pilot — Marissa will send the amendment for signature. Once DocuSign is complete, Monica will encumber the credit cap and schedule reminders.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/MPA-12345

Thanks everyone — Sean

Sean Gallagher
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: docusign-MPA-12345.pdf
